processAndRetentionReview.phasePopulation: One prevalidation process, eleven replay processes and eleven comparison processes.
processAndRetentionReview.groupStopEvidence: The final retained receipts report processGroupStopped:true for all 23 phases, with exit code zero. Adjacent finish/start timestamps establish serialization within this runner. The reviewer did not resample operating-system process IDs after completion or make a claim about other concurrent project tasks.
processAndRetentionReview.boundedness: Each child starts in a separate process group. Phase deadlines use the remaining campaign work budget. The supervisor applies SIGTERM/SIGKILL grace periods and forbids starting the next child if the preceding group is still alive.
processAndRetentionReview.deadlineLimit: The 2400-second campaign work budget is not an absolute wall-clock bound inclusive of termination graces, final retention and every synchronous hashing/fsync operation.
processAndRetentionReview.memoryLimit: The 1536-MiB setting bounds Node old-space only. It does not bound aggregate RSS or Python comparison memory.
processAndRetentionReview.durableEvidence: Raw stdout/stderr are written directly to exclusive files. Started/running/final receipts and failures are retained. Final replay reports are exposed only after complete streaming serialization, file fsync and an exclusive final link. Hard interruption can leave an owned .inprogress directory; no incomplete final report is thereby qualified.
processAndRetentionReview.rawDataLimit: The reviewer verified compressed byte hashes and metadata consistency, without decoding the eleven replay reports or the twenty-two historical archives. Semantic replay comparisons are the completed parent-run comparisons pinned here.
